description: Put the project on the map: an address (looked up; the first match is used, and the matches are returned) or latitude/longitude, and north: degrees true north is turned clockwise from the plan's north (up). The map, terrain and neighbouring buildings load around it, and set_sun can then light it. Map coordinates (georeferencing, for IFC and DXF exports): epsg picks the grid (the reply lists the ones worked out for the place, e.g. 7854 GDA2020 / MGA zone 54; 0 takes them off), height is the origin's height above the datum in metres, and easting/northing (metres) give a survey's numbers for the origin instead of working them out (needed for any other EPSG code). Changes the project's saved site (not an undo step).

address.description: Street address or place, e.g. "322 King William St, Adelaide"

easting.description: Surveyed easting of the origin, metres

epsg.description: Map grid's EPSG code; 0 removes map coordinates

gridNorth.description: With a survey: degrees grid north is clockwise from true north (default 0)

height.description: Origin height above the datum, metres

north.description: Degrees clockwise from plan north (default: unchanged, 0 for a new site)

northing.description: Surveyed northing of the origin, metres

name: set_site
title: Set the site location
